title: proposed-for/v1
description: nodes/<id>/proposed-for/<timestamp>-<pseudonym>.yaml (F18-R8; D-14 v3.26, D-3): which other node of the same target a statement was proposed for, written by the node's proposer or a listed curator. Append-only; the latest by file name is the one shown. A pointer, not a dependency: no status, frontier entry or dependency is derived from it. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

for.description: The node of the same target this statement was proposed for: a live node, never the record's own.

author.description: The pseudonym that wrote the record: the node's proposer (META.yaml provenance.author) or a listed curator.

note.description: Why, in the author's words; contributor free text, untrusted downstream.
